_comment: Each collection is versioned by embedding model; the app uses the alias.
Switching embedding models = create new collections, re-embed, move the alias.
Bodies below are passed as-is to PUT /collections/{name} and PUT /collections/{name}/index.

collections.name: posts__embeddinggemma_300m
collections.description: One vector per post/article. Point id = posts.uuid. Used for similar-post search, cross-language matching and clustering.

collections.name: claims__embeddinggemma_300m
collections.description: One vector per extracted claim. Point id = claims.uuid. Finds the same claim in other posts/languages so it is fact-checked once.

collections.name: categories__embeddinggemma_300m
collections.description: One prototype vector per category (description + example posts). Point id = categories.prototype_uuid. First, cheap pass of 'which category does this post fall in'; Gemma confirms close calls.

collections.name: clusters__embeddinggemma_300m
collections.description: Cluster centroids. Point id = clusters.centroid_uuid. Assigns a newly analyzed post to the nearest known cluster/narrative instantly, without re-clustering.
